…check pass while the app still couldn't reach your Supabase project. To fix it, add one line to a file named `.env` in the project folder (create the file if it isn't there): `SUPABASE_URL=` followed by your project's web address. You'll find it in your Supabase dashboard under Project Settings, then API. It looks like `https://yourproject.supabase.co`. If you run the app on a hosting service, you can put the same setting in the host's settings instead. The web address isn't secret, so I can add that line to the .env file for you if you send it. What is your Supabase project's web address?
